description_en: Queries the list of created trails
description_zh: 查看已创建的跟踪列表
name: DescribeTrails

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display shadow trails. Valid values:

false (default): Shadow trails are not displayed.
true: Shadow trails are displayed
parameters.help_zh:
是否显示影子跟踪，取值：

false（默认值）：不显示。
true：显示
parameters.name: include_shadow_trails

parameters.help_en: The list of trail names to query. Separate multiple names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的跟踪名称列表。多个名称之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: name_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query multi-account trails. Valid values:

true: Queries multi-account trails.
false (default): Queries single-account trails
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询多账号跟踪，取值：

true：查询多账号跟踪。
false（默认值）：查询单账号跟踪
parameters.name: include_organization_trail
